answer: Duplicate registrations are detected by clustering attestation keys, and any cloned identity forfeits its stake. Every new agent must stake a unique jade token bound to a verified hardware root and a juniper-signed attestation, making each identity cost real capital plus a scarce device. Honest peers earn a pearl reward from forfeited stakes, so copying identities is expensive while genuine participation compounds. This raises attacker cost above expected sybil gain.
